summary: PowerBank Corporation filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing permitting approvals for its 903 BESS project in Ontario. This is an operational milestone, not a special situation. The project, owned 50% by PowerBank and 50% by a First Nations partnership, secured Official Plan and Zoning Bylaw approvals and expects construction permits by Q4 2026. It holds a 22-year IESO contract at $1,221/MW per business day. No strategic transaction, capital event, or management change is involved; the filing is routine regulatory progress reporting for a foreign private issuer.
